info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Replace Fitness Memberships Renew-v1-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Renewal API enables gym and fitness center operators to update existing memberships efficiently. This endpoint allows for the bulk renewal of fitness memberships, ensuring that members do not experience disruptions in service. Typical consumers include gym management systems and member self-service applications that streamline the renewal process. By using this API, businesses can enhance member satisfaction and maintain continuity of membership benefits.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to renew their existing memberships, ensuring continued access to benefits and services associated with the membership.

requestBody.description: Renew an existing membership by providing the necessary information in the request body.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the membership.

customer.description: The details of the customer requesting the membership renewal.

amount.description: The amount to be processed for the renewal.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is specified.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required upon processing this request.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp of when the request was made.

channel.description: The channel through which the request is made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record in a list of requests.

ReplaceFitnessMembershipsRenewRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for renewing a membership operation.
